Taiki Shuttle wins the award for Best 
Sprinter at the URA Awards. However, it 
was Air Groove who was chosen as "Horse 
Girl of the Year."

However, Taiki Shuttle wasn't discouraged 
at all. Taking pride in the speed her 
Trainer believed in, she boldly declared 
that next time, she would become Horse of 
the Year.

To that end, she vows to win every GⅠ race 
she enters, carving the awe of her speed 
and power deep into the hearts of everyone 
watching.

"...With renewed determination, the two 
decided to start off by entering the 
Yasuda Kinen, the race that crowns the 
spring mile champion!"
